why: Boundary n8 cites civil-code 13 (Algerian law alone when one spouse was Algerian at the marriage); the store holds only the original wording referring to articles 11 and 12, and its note records a cross-reference discrepancy. The wording in force after the 2005 amendment of the Civil Code (law 05-10) is needed.

article: registration of divorce judgments (marginal entry on the marriage certificate)
why: Family-code 21 and 49 paragraph 3 refer to the civil-status law for registering marriages and divorce judgments; that law is not in the store.

article: international jurisdiction of Algerian courts in divorce (marital home or defendant abroad)
why: cpca 41 and 42 cover only contractual obligations; no text in the store says which Algerian court hears a divorce when the marital home or the wife is abroad (slot defendant_resides_abroad).
